drafts.title: Draft into notes
drafts.placeholder: Describe the note you want AI to draft...

prompts.summaryPage: Create a polished Markdown summary of page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}}. Include concise headings, action items if relevant, and a Sources section.
prompts.summaryNotebook: Create a polished Markdown summary of notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}}. Include key themes, open questions, and a Sources section.
prompts.outlinePage: Create a clearer Markdown outline for page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}}. Preserve the important ideas and organize them into headings and bullet points.
prompts.outlineNotebook: Create a high-level Markdown outline for notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}}. Group related pages into coherent sections.
prompts.rewritePage: Rewrite page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}} as polished Markdown. Keep factual content, improve structure and clarity, and include a Sources section.
prompts.rewriteNotebook: Create a polished Markdown synthesis of notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}}. Improve structure and clarity without inventing unsupported facts.
prompts.expandPage: Expand page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}} into a fuller Markdown draft. Preserve the existing facts, add useful explanation, and include a Sources section.
prompts.expandNotebook: Expand notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}} into a fuller Markdown guide. Use notebook context as source material and avoid unsupported facts.
prompts.continuePage: Continue page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}} with the next useful Markdown section. Match the existing style and include a Sources section.
prompts.continueNotebook: Continue notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}} by drafting the next useful Markdown section or page concept. Cite source pages when relevant.

prompts.summarizePage: Summarize the CodeCafe page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}}. Use notebook tools first and cite the notebook slug and page path.
prompts.summarizeNotebook: Summarize the CodeCafe notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}}. Use notebook tools first and cite notebook slugs and page paths where relevant.
prompts.relatedPage: Find notes related to the page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}}. Explain why each result is relevant and cite page paths.
prompts.relatedNotebook: Find the most relevant notes inside notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}}. Group results by theme and cite page paths.
prompts.outlinePage: Suggest a clearer outline for the page "{{pageTitle}}" in notebook {{notebookSlug}} at path {{pagePath}}. Do not edit the notebook; return a concise proposed structure.
prompts.outlineNotebook: Suggest a clearer high-level outline for notebook "{{notebookTitle}}" with slug {{notebookSlug}}. Do not edit the notebook; return a concise proposed structure.
